profiles.review_question: Which connected source areas and riparian interventions improve the catchment's nutrient and sediment pressures around the recreation concern?
profiles.outcome_label: Modeled nutrient and sediment change; observed E. coli condition
profiles.observation_basis: Original bacteria results and sampling dates

profiles.review_question: Where do candidate nutrient interventions reduce catchment inputs, and how do the observed pH direction, chlorophyll and surface-water conditions relate to that management question?
profiles.outcome_label: Modeled nutrient export; observed pH condition
profiles.observation_basis: Original surface pH observations, direction and dates

profiles.review_question: Which connected erosion or nutrient hotspots overlap the biological concern and merit focused restoration and biological follow-up?
profiles.outcome_label: Modeled catchment pressures; observed macroinvertebrate condition
profiles.observation_basis: Original biological indices, classification and survey dates

profiles.review_question: Which upland erosion interventions offer a sediment-management benefit within this fish-consumption concern's catchment?
profiles.outcome_label: Modeled upland sediment export; fish-tissue PCB assessment
profiles.observation_basis: Original fish-tissue results, species and advisory

profiles.review_question: Which connected interventions most reduce modeled nitrogen delivery toward the Eighteen Mile Creek arm?
profiles.outcome_label: Modeled annual nitrogen export and scenario change
profiles.observation_basis: Source-calculated annual nitrogen loads for the matching contributing area

profiles.review_question: Which connected interventions most reduce modeled phosphorus delivery toward the Eighteen Mile Creek arm?
profiles.outcome_label: Modeled annual phosphorus export and scenario change
profiles.observation_basis: Source-calculated annual phosphorus loads for the matching contributing area

profiles.review_question: Which erosion-control scenarios reduce modeled overland sediment entering the arm's connected stream network?
profiles.observation_basis: Annual sediment loads derived with original discharge and a site-supported sediment/turbidity relation

map_review: Render the original monitoring location. HUC12 summaries use the label 'Contains listed monitoring site'; retain the hydrologic contributing-area selection separately.

Keep assessment status and priority at site/use/cause level. At SV-268, display TN/TP restoration, turbidity priority, pH protection context, Pb water-of-concern and the fecal-coliform TMDL as separate records.
Priority 1 means 2026-2028 agency planning, 2 means 2028-2030, and 3 means after 2030. All four RFP focus watersheds remain in the delivery.

Retain native comparison direction alternative-minus-baseline. A reduction-positive display is derived as baseline-minus-alternative, equal to the negative of the native comparison, and labeled explicitly.

Raw InVEST 3.20 output rasters are rates per hectare. Multiply raw values by actual pixel area in hectares once when aggregating annual mass; a 30 m square pixel is 0.09 ha. The workspace nitrogen_export, phosphorus_export and sediment_export artifacts already pass through model.rasters.rate_to_mass and are annual mass per pixel. Sum those artifacts directly over their retained support. Native watershed totals are already annual masses.
Measure nutrient retention at catchment scale or through export differences between scenarios. Map candidate interventions by their rerun effect on downstream export.

Join original annual-load observations through model.observations using their actual catchment ID, parameter, unit, period and source method. Retain grab concentrations, pH, bacteria, biological and fish-tissue observations in the assessment/source context.

For reservoir comparisons, carry the selected contributing area and original source periods with the results; use a named reservoir-retention treatment where the comparison includes in-reservoir processes.
